title: An der Wiek, Klütz
description:
Experience the perfect blend of comfort and convenience 🏡 in this spacious 143 m2 apartment nestled in the serene setting of Jesendorf 🌿. This charming 5-room apartment comfortably accommodates up to six guests 🛏️, making it an ideal choice for families or groups of friends seeking a relaxing getaway.

The well-equipped kitchen 🍳 features cooking supplies, an oven, fridge, dishwasher, and freezer ❄️, ensuring meal prep is effortless. The living area 🛋️ includes a TV for entertainment, and the washing machine 🧺 adds a touch of home-like convenience.

Refresh and unwind in the bathroom 🚿🛁, which includes both a shower and a bathtub, or step out onto the private terrace 🌞 to enjoy the fresh air. With six single beds, every guest has their own comfortable space. Located on the first floor of a two-story building, this apartment offers a peaceful retreat with all the essentials for a memorable stay 🌟.

Additional perks include wheelchair accessibility ♿, parking options 🚗, and thoughtful starter supplies like dishwashing detergent, hand soap, greaseproof paper, and toilet paper 🧴.

🧹Optional bi-weekly cleaning service ✨: Keep your space sparkling and stress-free with our convenient cleaning option, available for just €455 per month 💶.
